Hymn 122: Though Deepening Trials
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: George Careless
Lyricist/Text Author: Eliza R. Snow
Category: Prayer and Supplication

This is hymn number 122 titled "Though Deepening Trials" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by George Careless and the lyrics were written by Eliza R. Snow.
This hymn is categorized under: Prayer and Supplication.
